title: 第20章 收获第21章 回城
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
沃尔皱着眉头仔细观察，他也是第一次见到哥布林的巢穴，虽然有所预料，但亲眼所见和听他人讲述的区别还是很大的。
按照学校的说法，哥布林这种行为，是在试图以血肉、灵魂、痛苦向恶魔献祭，以求获得强大的力量。
这也是哥布林异化个体的来源之一，但这种异化个体出现的概率很低，没有精准目标的献祭几乎不可能成功，况且以哥布林的智力和实力，祭品的品质也没什么恶魔会感兴趣。
在血肉模糊的巢穴中，还有几个不停蠕动抽搐的生物，依稀还能看出羊和蜥蜴的形状。
“是那些被抢走的牲畜。”
这时，就到出发前购买的铲子发挥作用的时候了。
“先挖出一条路来。”
命令下达，霍恩挺身而出，将表面的残骸用铁铲掀到一边，扎木合则拿着武器上前，先用尖刃斧枪帮助这些痛苦挣扎的动物解脱，然后用一柄短刃划开那些鼓胀的肚子，顿时一大团蠕动的绿色肉球流出。
这便是整个哥布林巢穴唯一有价值的东西，哥布林胚胎，在某些高级炼金药剂的材料表中，价格不低。
至于那些动物，被污染的活肉块而已，没有任何价值。
用特制麻袋将这些黏糊糊的恶心东西装好，最后让士兵们将整个巢穴用薄土掩埋，这一次行动便算结束了。
其实最好的解决办法是将其烧掉，而且不必担心会引发森林大火，里面的动植物会帮忙灭火的。
但有可能会引起森林怪物的暴动，给附近的农庄带去毁灭性的灾难，实属不必要。
“大地能净化一切污秽！”
做完这一切，沃尔指挥部队原路返回，在青狼的侦查下，部队不仅没遇到麻烦，还挖到两颗颇有价值的药草，还有一根哀嚎刺藤，被扎中的人会感觉极其痛苦，发出惨烈哀嚎，最终导致死亡。
在太阳彻底落山之前，部队终于离开阴暗的森林回到农庄，所有士兵不由都长呼一口气。
在看过哥布林巢穴后，又在越来越暗的森林中行走，给这些还没有经过大风大浪的士兵造成了极大的心理压力。
沃尔时刻观察着部队的士气，虽然有所降低，但仍然高于60，没有崩溃的风险。
但他还是下令先进行休整，饮用圣水，架锅烧饭，吃点东西恢复状态。
大约一个小时后，沃尔让一半士兵着甲警戒，另一半开始学着处理哥布林的尸体。

“哥布林的价值，大部分就在它的皮上，有几个破洞不碍事，但剥皮的时候还是越完整越好。”
沃尔穿着一套灰色麻衣，戴着一双皮手套，手拿尖锐剥皮小刀，一边讲解，一边做示范。
刺啦～
他的动作标准而富有节奏，很快如同脱衣服一般，剥下一张完整哥布林皮，和一片带着耳朵的哥布林头皮。
啪！
将皮子扔进装满草木灰的木盆中，他继续讲道：
“哥布林是魔物，但蕴含的恶魔力量很微弱，将其埋入土中三天左右，邪恶力量就会自行退散，我们不需要这么麻烦，回到城镇，直接卖给那些皮革商人就行。”
讲解完后，沃尔走到一边，让士兵们逐一上前尝试。
这里可没有娇生惯养的人，士兵们对这种活没什么排斥，不过都还挺克制，毕竟这可是能卖钱的。
士兵们忙活起来，沃尔终于有了一点空闲时间，他坐到一旁的箱子上，开始翻阅神器战旗内的信息。
content_en:
Wall frowned and observed carefully. It was also the first time for him to see the Goblin's lair. Although he had expected it, there was still a big difference between seeing it with his own eyes and listening to other people's stories.
According to the school, this behavior of goblins is an attempt to sacrifice their flesh, soul, and pain to the devil in order to gain powerful power.
This is also one of the sources of Goblin alienated individuals, but the probability of such alienated individuals appearing is very low, and a sacrifice without a precise target is almost impossible to succeed. Moreover, with the intelligence and strength of the Goblin, the quality of the sacrifice is not something that demons would be interested in.
In the bloody lair, there are several squirming and twitching creatures, and the shapes of sheep and lizards can still be vaguely seen.
"It's the livestock that were stolen."
At this point, it’s time for the shovel purchased before departure to come into play.
"First dig a path."
After the order was given, Horn stepped forward and pushed aside the debris on the surface with a shovel. Zhamuhe stepped forward with a weapon. He first used a sharp-edged ax gun to help free the struggling animals, and then used a short blade to cut open the bulging bellies. Suddenly, a large group of squirming green meat balls flowed out.
This is the only valuable thing in the entire Goblin lair. Goblin embryos are found in the material list of some advanced alchemy potions, and the price is not low.
As for those animals, they are just contaminated pieces of live meat and have no value.
These sticky and disgusting things were packed in special sacks, and finally the soldiers were asked to bury the entire nest with a thin layer of soil. This operation was considered over.
In fact, the best solution is to burn it, and you don't have to worry about starting a forest fire. The animals and plants inside will help put out the fire.
However, it may cause a riot by forest monsters and bring devastating disaster to nearby farms, which is really unnecessary.
"The earth can purify all filth!"
After doing all this, Wall commanded the troops to return the same way. Under the investigation of Qinglang, the troops not only did not encounter any trouble, but also dug up two valuable medicinal herbs and a wailing thorn vine. Those who were stabbed would feel extremely painful and let out miserable wailing, eventually leading to death.
Before the sun completely set, the troops finally left the dark forest and returned to the farm. All the soldiers couldn't help but let out a long breath.
After seeing the goblin lair and walking in the increasingly dark forest, it caused great psychological pressure on these soldiers who had not experienced strong winds and waves.
Wall was always observing the morale of the troops. Although it had dropped, it was still above 60, and there was no risk of collapse.
But he still ordered to rest first, drink holy water, set up a pot to cook, and eat something to restore his condition.
About an hour later, Wall asked half of the soldiers to put on armor and be on guard, while the other half began to learn how to handle the goblin corpse.
"Most of the value of a goblin lies in its skin. A few holes are not a problem, but the more intact the skin is, the better."
Wall wore a gray linen suit, a pair of leather gloves, and held a sharp skinning knife while explaining and demonstrating.
Stab ~
His movements were standard and rhythmic, and he quickly peeled off a complete goblin skin and a piece of goblin scalp with ears, just like taking off his clothes.
Snap!
Throwing the leather into a tub filled with plant ashes, he continued to preach:
"Goblin is a monster, but the demonic power it contains is very weak. If you bury it in the soil for about three days, the evil power will dissipate on its own. We don't need to go to such trouble. We can just go back to the town and sell it directly to the leather merchants."
After the explanation, Wall stepped aside and let the soldiers come forward one by one to try.
There are no pampered people here. The soldiers are not opposed to this kind of work, but they are quite restrained. After all, this can be sold for money.
The soldiers got busy, and Wall finally had some free time. He sat on the box nearby and began to read the information in the artifact battle flag.
